description: reVX is a set of command-line tools maintained by the U.S. National Laboratory of the Rockies for moving renewable resource and siting analyses into power-system modelling workflows. Its documented commands prepare reV inputs and outputs, PLEXOS plant mappings, renewable portfolio measures, wind directions, setbacks and offshore distances to ports. Inputs are resource and exclusion layers plus technology configuration; outputs are transformed tables and geospatial files for renewable development studies. Spatial and temporal coverage follow the chosen source layers, often in U.S. regions. Source is free under BSD-3-Clause on GitHub and PyPI, with documentation and an installation guide. A limitation is that the package depends on compatible reV data and geospatial assumptions; a PLEXOS export does not itself validate a grid model. It can prepare renewable build-out and coastal wind inputs for capacity-planning simulations. The catalogue's model-pypsa is a separate power-system model that may consume prepared renewable assumptions after explicit mapping; interoperability was not tested. No resource file was fetched.
